verses.text: When the earth is shaken with its [final] earthquake
And the earth discharges its burdens[1]
And man says,[2] "What is [wrong] with it?" -
That Day, it will report its news
Because your Lord has inspired [i.e., commanded] it.
That Day, the people will depart[3] separated [into categories] to be shown [the result of] their deeds.
So whoever does an atom's weight[4] of good will see it,
And whoever does an atom's weight of evil will see it.

footnotes.3: From the place of Judgement to their final abode. Another interpretation is "emerge separately" (from the graves) .
footnotes.4: Or "the weight of a small ant."
